allowedPurpose: One targeted actual-raster V judgment on the exact new expression asset and its actual supplied browser views.

findings.finding: The two-panel model varies recognition of the same plasmid-borne promoter while preserving the DNA symbol. It supports the stated supplied-model goal and its conclusion that DNA presence alone does not establish target-protein formation.

Each plasmid remains one circular DNA-map symbol. The promoter points in the direction of the adjacent blue coding segment; nothing places a promoter on RNA or represents the protein as DNA. The blue segment is intentionally not separately labelled Gen; this omission reduces autonomous legend detail but creates no contrary biological assertion in this orientation image.

The left pathway is DNA to mRNA passing through the ribosome to a distinct folded target protein. Arrows move left to right with no RNA-to-DNA reversal or DNA-directly-to-protein bypass. RNA polymerase, ribosome-binding site, tRNA and detailed kinetics are omitted, an acceptable schematic boundary for this atomic orientation.

findings.criterion: negative result bounded to target gene
findings.finding: The right-hand label is Kein Zielprotein, not Kein Protein. It does not assert that the whole bacterial host loses endogenous protein synthesis. The dashed arrow plus red X denotes the failed target-expression path; it is not a molecular conversion into an X.

findings.criterion: bacterial host and circular DNA coherence
findings.finding: Both hosts are stylized bacterial silhouettes without a nuclear compartment. Promoter and blue DNA arc remain on the circular plasmid map; segment outlines are schematic and do not depict broken linear DNA, cleavage, separate chromosomes or a plasmid moved into a nucleus.

The 1672 by 941 PNG is a native near-16:9 raster. Rounded shapes, pastel cell panels, black lettering and large colored molecular symbols match the inspected old original; no watermark, technical ID or visible provider artifact is present.

The actual 360 by 203 browser PNG retains readable main contrast and individually decipherable short object labels. The 680 by 383 PNG makes all labels clear. All objects and arrowheads remain visible without crop; the picture is no longer dependent on long explanatory paragraphs.

The current matching-ID primary image link retains provider, language, CC-BY-4.0 and pilot status. Its specific alt text describes the same two-host, promoter, mRNA, ribosome and target-protein contrast. This is an image overview and supplies no performance or source-coverage evidence.

nonBlockingLimits: This is a supplied qualitative promoter-compatibility model. A recognized promoter is not a universal sufficient condition for real-world protein yield; compatible host transcription and translation conditions are assumed and represented schematically.
The blue coding segment has no standalone Gen label. That does not invalidate this compact orientation; explanation and practice still need to identify the inserted coding sequence.
